Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog: Waiting co-hosts now see the on-stage DJ's real title, seek bar, elapsed/remaining time, and live visualizer on their own decks, plus an Up Next queue in the Host Lobby, and can send song requests straight to the lead from their own Playlist. Fixed several silent connect/broadcast failures that showed no error message, and a bug where an accepted song request displayed a garbled ID instead of the real track title.
